Music Assistant on your Samsung TV: now playing, karaoke lyrics, party mode with the guest QR code, and the TV as a synced speaker.

**Install:** download `MusicAssistantTV.wgt` below and install it with [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung): choose a custom `.wgt` and pick the file. Apps2Samsung signs it for your TV. The README has the details.

Needs Music Assistant 2.10 or newer.
